text: Hello, this is the fraud department at First Harbor Bank. We noticed unusual activity on your account.
To protect your money, we need you to move it to a safe account right now.
Please do not hang up, the account will be frozen within the hour.
I am calling from your bank's security team about a suspicious transfer from your savings.
I will need your online banking code to cancel it before it clears.
If you tell anyone at the branch, the investigation will be compromised.
This is the Internal Revenue Service. There is a warrant issued in your name for unpaid taxes.
You can resolve this today by paying with gift cards, and you must stay on the line.
Do not speak to a lawyer, it will only make the penalties higher.
We have a final notice regarding your tax return and you owe four thousand dollars immediately.
Go to the nearest store and read me the numbers on the back of the cards.
If you do not pay in thirty minutes, officers will arrive at your home.
Hello, I am from Microsoft support. Your computer has sent us a virus alert.
I need you to open the remote access tool so that I can fix it for you.
Do not turn off the computer, your files will be deleted if you do.
Our system shows hackers are inside your laptop at this very moment.
Please type the code I give you and then log into your bank so I can check it is safe.
There is a one time fee of three hundred dollars to remove the infection.
Grandma, it is me. I am in trouble and I need your help, please do not tell mom.
I was in a car accident and the police are here, I need money for bail today.
A lawyer is going to call you, please just do what he says.
Hi Grandpa, I lost my phone so this is a new number, I am in a real bind.
I cannot talk long, can you wire the money to this account for me right now?
Please do not tell anyone, I am so embarrassed and I will pay you back.
